title: The project directory now leads with what the community is using
summary:
A directory-focused day: better project discovery, cleaner chat history, and a refreshed Mistral model.

Project listings now show GitHub star counts and sort by popularity, making it easier to find the apps people have already put through their paces. ImageGen AI Image also joined the list, while CSV exports were reordered to better match the directory.

Conversation history now avoids showing duplicate ads. A small change, but repeated UI furniture is how software slowly becomes haunted.

The Mistral model configuration was refreshed, keeping the multi-model text endpoint current alongside the rest of the ecosystem.
